Acts may change, but the architects of emotion endure.

Respect due. Flowers given.

The Trump administration has proposed a legal settlement to end the Biden-era Saving on a Valuable Education (SAVE) Plan for student loan repayment. If approved by the court, over 7 million current enrollees would be required to transition to other repayment options that comply with legal requirements. The Department of Education would stop accepting new applications, deny pending ones, and give existing participants a limited window to choose an alternative plan.

A few fascinating facts about this incredible place:
	• Over 500 million years old — the sandstone here was carved by the Ausable River long before dinosaurs.
	• Often called the “Grand Canyon of the Adirondacks,” with cliffs rising up to 150 feet.
	• The chasm helped shape early American tourism; guided tours

Strip weaving is a vibrant art form in West Africa. This stunning piece was created by the Bobo people, one of the largest ethnic groups in Burkina Faso. Weavers throughout the region use this traditional method—working on horizontal looms with foot pedals to craft long, narrow bands of cloth that are then sewn together to create wrappers, gowns, blankets, and more. 

See it on view in Seyd

“These are people who can’t make ends meet, and my heart goes out to each and every one of them. Their pets are like their family,” DeCando said.

.
Founded: 1966 by Dr. Maulana Karenga
.
Purpose: To reinforce African values, culture, and collective responsibility.
.

.

combined_text:
Kwanzaa is a cultural holiday celebrated from December 26 to January 1, honoring African heritage, unity, and community, especially among people of African descent in the United States.
.
Key points about Kwanzaa
.
Founded: 1966 by Dr. Maulana Karenga
.
Purpose: To reinforce African values, culture, and collective responsibility.
.
Not a religious holiday: It’s cultural, so people of any faith can observe it
.
The Seven Principles (Nguzo Saba)
.
Each day focuses on one principle:
	1.	Umoja – Uni KWANZAA
A SEVEN DAY
CELEBRATION
OF AFRICAN

Kwanzaa is a cultural holiday celebrated from December 26 to January 1, honoring African heritage, unity, and community, especially among people of African descent in the United States.
.
Key points about Kwanzaa
.
Founded: 1966 by Dr. Maulana Karenga
.
Purpose: To reinforce African values, culture, and collective responsibility.
.
Not a religious holiday: It’s cultural, so people of any faith can observe it
.
The Seven Principles (Nguzo Saba)
.
Each day focuses on one principle:
	1.	Umoja – Uni KWANZAA
A SEVEN DAY
CELEBRATION
OF AFRICAN
CULTURE,
HISTORY
AND THE
HARVEST.
Dec. 26: UMOJA (Unity)
Dec. 27: KUJICHAGULIA (Self-Determination)
Dec. 28: UMIJA (Collective Work)
Dec. 29: UJAMAA (Cooperative Economics)
Dec. 30: NIA (Purpose)
Dec. 31: KUUMBA (Creativity)

Kwanzaa is a cultural holiday celebrated from December 26 to January 1, honoring African heritage, unity, and community, especially among people of African descent in the United States.
.
Key points about Kwanzaa
.
Founded: 1966 by Dr. Maulana Karenga
.
Purpose: To reinforce African values, culture, and collective responsibility.
.
Not a religious holiday: It’s cultural, so people of any faith can observe it
.
The Seven Principles (Nguzo Saba)
.
Each day focuses on one principle:
	1.	Umoja – Uni KWANZAA
A SEVEN DAY
CELEBRATION
OF AFRICAN
CULTURE,
HISTORY
AND THE
HARVEST.

Dec. 27: KUJICHAGULIA (Self-Determination)

combined_text:
Starting January 1, 2026, a new federal tax rule will significantly change how gambling losses are treated in the United States. Our strip woven textile from the Arts of Global Africa collection has traveled to the Brooklyn Museum! ✨ 

Strip weaving is a vibrant art form in West Africa. This stunning piece was created by the Bobo people, one of the largest ethnic groups in Burkina Faso. Weavers throughout the region use this traditional method—working on horizontal looms with foot pedals to craft long, narrow bands of cloth that are then sewn together to create wrappers, gowns, blankets, and more.

Tomasello Winery has been making great wine in the Garden State for almost a century. The cameras giving out parking tickets in Hoboken could be going dark for about a month.

description: Follow-up notices will be sent to owners of affected 2025-2026 Camry Hybrid and 2026 Corolla Hybrid vehicles when repair details are finalized.
display_url_note: CDN URL - expires after few hours/days
combined_text:
Toyota is recalling more than 55,000 hybrid vehicles after discovering that a bolt inside the inverter assembly may not have been properly tightened, potentially leading to a loss of drive power. According to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration, the issue could create an open circuit, increasing the risk of a crash, especially at higher speeds. In rare cases, it could also raise the risk of a fire.

combined_text:
1 year old Sadie was given up and fostered in the same week — talk about an unlucky and lucky turn of events!

This young, beautiful girl was scooped up into a foster home just days after being surrendered to the shelter. While it was a big, sudden change, Sadie is already showing everyone what a resilient and sweet dog she is.

Her fosters say she’s been a wonderful houseguest so far — she has great leash manners, did great for her first bath, and enjoys some fun zoomies to get her wiggles out!
